purpose: Office Spider stage-spec: storyboard-derived camera set + a compact cubicle-corner interior set for shader render tests. Companion to specs/humber_toon_spine/prototype_renders.v1.json (which owns the brutalist exterior vista level).
source_of_truth: Docs/OFFICE_SPIDER_SHOT_PLAN.md section 7 (open gaps -- what is deliberately deferred)
orchestrator_note: 12 owner sequences (Content/Sequences/Shots/SH*, 30fps 0-150 shells) + OfficeSpider_Master are the owner's staged shells and are NOT touched by this pass: this spec stages the CAMERAS + SET for still render tests. Break-room/kitchen shell and the worker/spider rigs are the plan's queued gaps (7.11/7.12) -- shots that need them are listed defer_reason, not staged.

levels.name: exterior (already staged)
levels.note: The composed brutalist exterior vista already carries Cam_Env_SH010 at 24mm per the boards' opening framing. Not rebuilt by this pass.

levels.name: office interior stage
levels.note: Lean cubicle-corner set: floor + back/side walls (open top for light), the Canonical cubicle unit, paper props, drop-ceiling troffer glows. One set, five storyboard cameras.

render_tier.name: prototype
render_tier.filmback_note: Required 16:9; the capture reframes silently otherwise (measured 2026-10-01).
render_tier.output_note: Prototype stills are regenerable local output; the JSON report is the committed evidence.

level.name: L_Toon_Shot_Office
level.why_separate: L_Brutalist_Layout stays the untouched review grid; L_Toon_Shot_Env stays the exterior vista. A bay-sized interior is neither.

ground.note: VCT floor reads grout grid + forge the toon bands; min.z lifted to 0 by the builder's measured grounding pass.

lights.lighting_note: Open-top studio cube. The key light comes FROM the camera side so the visible wall/cubicle/desk faces catch direct sun (the first staged render, 2026-10-08, was black - the key was aimed at the wall's back). The fill is a second directional against the key, and the troffers are the interior emitters. 2026-10-08 v02 fix: the SLS_CapturedScene Skylight captured a BLACK VOID (no sky content to capture) -> zero ambient under sun-lit faces; with the project's fixed exposure (r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure=False) sun 5.0 blew the lit faces white while shadows went black. atmosphere:true gives the capture real sky; the builder re-captures after the atmosphere exists and adds an unbounded PPV so the exposure law lives in the level.

scene.note: Thin slab: 12x12 m, 20 cm thick, top face at z=0. The native cube is 100 uu per side, so the scale value IS the extent in metres.
Bottom z=0, top ~+30: the zone every sits-on prop lands on.
Slim wall cubes (bottom 0, top +310) so a level tilt has room against a windowless interior.

scene.role: hero workstation (partitions already assigned MI_Toon_Office_Polypropylene via the office-set builder)
scene.note: Measured 1023 x 660 x 219 uu in run 5 - the Canonical unit carries its own desk/partitions.
Prop material gap: the staged prop FBX row is unassigned; a placeholder-grey read on this prop is the record, not a pass.
MI_OfficeSpider_Paper carries T_SDF_PaperGrain + bMatteFinish. The cubicle's AABB spans its own furniture, so paper/sticky/chair/lamp rows carry overlap_ok_with for the immediate zone.
No desk surface measured yet; the lamp stands on the floor this pass (the cubicle's own furniture is its content).

scene.role: sticky notes row (board pg1 shot 9 supplies)
drop-ceiling rail (a gall, not a lid -- never blocks the key light)
scene.note: Bottom at +290 m... bottom at +290 uu, top at +350: reads as ceiling depth behind the level-framed shots.

evidence_contract.stills_note: Each still committed to the JSON report at Saved/Audit/render_prototype_report.json via the shared harness (render_prototypes.py with the request's spec override). The PNG is evidence only through the REPORT's measured IHDR dimensions + the camera's filmback aspect; the images themselves are read in review.
evidence_contract.shader_read_note: On this machine D3D12 now reports Max Feature Level SM6 (owner's config), so the Substrate toon read is expected REAL; a render that comes back default-material-looking is treated as a defect, not as the machine. The minimum passes are: VCT grout + toon bands on the floor, paper matte grain, partition polypropylene hatching, troffer emissive. A still missing them fails the render test.
